intentEvidence: Show icons in front of folders and files in the file explorer: open and closed folders, notes and all other files each get their own icon.
problem: The standard file explorer lacks visual cues to quickly identify file types and the state of folders.

relations.evidence: Works with Colored File Names: folders colored with the Colored File Names plugin show their icon in that color.

summary: Automatically displays distinct icons for folders, Markdown notes, and other file types in the file explorer using CSS.
